## LINK_ACCOUNTS

### 中文

## RESUME_MAJOR_VERSION_WARNING_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARESUME_MAJOR_VERSION_WARNING_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

正在恢复的存档来自§H$SAVE_VERSION$§!版本。\n当前游戏版本为§H$GAME_VERSION$§!。\n\n在大型更新前后的游戏存档通常无法匹配。若有需要，可以从主菜单手动载入该存档，但可能发生意外现象。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:960`

### English

The save game being resumed is from version §H$SAVE_VERSION$§!.\nThe current game version is §H$GAME_VERSION$§!.\n\nSave games are usually not compatible between major updates. You can manually load this save from the main menu if desired, though unexpected behavior may occur.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1013`

## RESUME_MAJOR_VERSION_WARNING_STEAM_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARESUME_MAJOR_VERSION_WARNING_STEAM_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

正在恢复的存档来自§H$SAVE_VERSION$§!版本。\n当前游戏版本为§H$GAME_VERSION$§!。\n\n如果希望继续游玩该存档，我们建议回滚至对应版本。（在Steam中右键点击Stellaris，属性...→游戏版本及测试版）

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:961`

### English

The save game being resumed is from version §H$SAVE_VERSION$§!.\nThe current game version is §H$GAME_VERSION$§!.\n\nIf you wish to continue playing this save, we suggest rolling back to the correct version. (Right-Click Stellaris in Steam, Properties -> Game Versions & Betas)

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1014`

## SAVE_INCOMPATIBLE_OLDER

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASAVE_INCOMPATIBLE_OLDER&lang=en)

### 中文

§R存档不兼容§!\n此存档的版本$SAVE_VERSION|H$与当前的游戏版本$GAME_VERSION|H$不兼容，会影响游戏稳定性。\n\n加载此存档然后保存成新的存档§H不会§!改变其兼容性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:962`

### English

§RIncompatible Save§!\nThis save of version $SAVE_VERSION|H$ is incompatible with the current game version $GAME_VERSION|H$, which will cause unexpected behavior when playing.\n\nCreating a new save from this save §Hdoes not§! make it compatible.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1015`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:963`

### English

§RPossibly Incompatible Save§!\nThis save of version $SAVE_VERSION|H$ is of newer version than the current game version $GAME_VERSION|H$, which might cause unexpected behavior when playing.\n\nCreating a new save from this save §Hmight not§! make it fully compatible.

## STARTUP_TEXT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTARTUP_TEXT&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎来到Stellaris 4.5“天鹅座”守护者更新！\n\n“天鹅座”是一个专注于修复与完善的更新。守护者团队在本周期内集中解决了崩溃和多人游戏不同步的问题，并修复了大家反馈的大量问题。\n\n4.5中包含一项重要的机制改动，它为我们今年晚些时候在“意志力”扩展包中计划的内容做好了铺垫。人口组不再按思潮分裂，因此每个组都是一个混合体，其人口会随着吸引力变化在主导思潮与次要思潮之间漂移。\n\n政策选项卡也经过了重做，改进了排序并新增了教条政策，让你能够更好地控制生成的舰队和恒星基地配置。在帝国创建器中，你还能对帝国地图和舰船颜色进行更多控制。\n\nStellaris现在原生支持Apple Silicon，因此使用M系列Mac的玩家在此次更新中应能感受到显著的性能提升。\n\n请注意，由于人口组和派系改动的规模，4.5会重置存档和模组兼容性。完整更新日志可通过下方链接查看。\n\n享受更新吧，感谢游玩Stellaris！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1020`

### English

Welcome to the Stellaris 4.5 'Cygnus' Custodian update!\n\nCygnus is an update about repair and refinement. The Custodians spent this cycle closing out crashes, multiplayer desyncs, and fixing a long list of issues you've been reporting.\n\nWe have one major mechanical change in 4.5, and it is scaffolding for what we're planning later this year in the Willpower expansion. Pop Groups no longer split by Ethics, so each Group is a blend with its Pops drifting between dominant and secondary ethics as attraction shifts.\n\nThe Policies tab has been reworked as well, with improved sorting and new Doctrine Policies to give you better control of your generated fleet and starbase loadouts. You'll also find more control over your empire's map and ship colors in the empire creator.\n\nStellaris now runs natively on Apple Silicon, so players on M-series Macs should see a significant performance increase with this update.\n\nPlease note that 4.5 resets save and mod compatibility due to the scope of the Pop Group and Faction changes. Complete release notes can be found through the link below.\n\nEnjoy the update, and thank you for playing Stellaris!

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1076`

## COUNTRY_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACOUNTRY_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

失落帝国是残留下的远古星际势力。虽然他们已不复往昔，但是他们仍然持有着及其先进的科技。星际的事务根本无法吸引他们，而他们也几乎不踏出自己的领域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1283`

### English

Fallen Empires are the stagnant remnants of the galactic powers of old. Though mere shadows of what they once were, they still possess incredibly advanced technology. Galactic affairs are of little interest to them, and they rarely venture beyond their own space.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1339`

## COUNTRY_AWAKENED_FALLEN_EMPIRE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACOUNTRY_AWAKENED_FALLEN_EMPIRE&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1284`

### English

Awakened Empire

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1340`

## COUNTRY_AWAKENED_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACOUNTRY_AWAKENED_FALLEN_EMPIRE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

觉醒帝国是从几个世纪的长期停滞中崛起的['concept_fallen_empires']，他们现在再次将魔爪伸向星系。他们是危险的邻居，很可能把不太先进的帝国作为他们的傀儡或者征服目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1285`

### English

Awakened Empires are ['concept_fallen_empires'] that have risen from their centuries-long stagnation and now reach out to grasp the galaxy once more. They are dangerous neighbors, likely to treat less advanced empires as puppets or targets of conquest.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1341`

### 中文

§H可用的超光速方式§!\n这一设定决定了帝国可以使用基于哪种理论的超光速旅行的手段。默认情况下，所有的三种理论（曲速理论、超空间引擎和虫洞理论）都是可供使用的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1642`

### English

§HAllowed FTL Method§!\nThis controls which method of Faster Than Light travel can be chosen by regular Empires. By default, all three methods (Warp, Hyperdrive and Wormholes) are enabled.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1701`

### 中文

§H递增难度§!\n当这个选项开启，电脑从§Y难度§!选项中获得的优势会随游戏时间递增，在游戏开始时为零，并在§Y游戏中期§!和§Y游戏终局的开始年份§!达到最大。

### 中文

§H电脑侵略性§!\n此项设置决定了电脑帝国有多大几率向敌人发动战争，当然也包括了在扩张中总体发动的战争数量。尽管有侵略性设置，在电脑对目标的态度符合判定的情况下他们依然只会选择宣战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1685`

### English

§HAI Aggressiveness§!\nThis controls how likely AI Empires are to declare war on their enemies, and thus the overall number of wars that are started over the course of a campaign. Regardless of the aggressiveness setting, the AI will still only declare war if their attitude towards the target permits it.

## DIFFICULTY_ADJUSTED_AI_MODIFIERS_TOOLTIP

### 中文

§H$DIFFICULTY_ADJUSTED_AI_MODIFIERS$§!\n电脑帝国的帝国范围资源产出修正将会与§Y难度§!加成进行乘算。例如，某项科技可以增加£job_miner£矿工岗位的+20%£minerals£$minerals$产出，对['concept_grand_admiral']的电脑帝国而言，开启该选项将变为+40%的修正。\n\n§P警告：§!这将会使末期电脑经济显著变强。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1688`

### English

§H$DIFFICULTY_ADJUSTED_AI_MODIFIERS$§!\nEmpire-wide economic modifiers are multiplied by §YDifficulty§! bonus for AI Empires. For example, a technology which gives +20% £minerals£ $minerals$ from £job_miner£ Miner Jobs will instead give +40% for AI Empires on ['concept_grand_admiral']. \n\n§PWarning:§! Turning this on makes Late-Game AI economies significantly stronger.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1747`

## FE_HABITABLE_WORLDS_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFE_HABITABLE_WORLDS_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H宜居星球§!\n该选项用于调节处于星系“黄金区域”的星球，也就是宜居星球的产生率。增大该数值会让星系总体上会有更多的宜居星球。即使设置为§Y$FE_HABITABLE_WORLDS_RARE$§!，宜居星球也同样会出现，但只在特定的恒星系中。\n\n§R警告§!将该设置提高到1×以上可能导致游戏后期的性能问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1720`

### English

§HHabitable Worlds§!\nThis setting adjusts the chance of a planet existing in the "goldilocks zone" of a solar system, and thus being habitable. Increasing this value results in a galaxy with more habitable worlds overall. On the §Y$FE_HABITABLE_WORLDS_RARE$§! setting, habitable worlds will still appear, but only in special systems.\n\n§RWarning:§! This setting may have late game performance implications if increased above 1x.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1779`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFE_VICTORY_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$FE_VICTORY$§!\n此选项决定在没有['concept_endgame_crisis']或['concept_war_in_heaven']存在的情况下，游戏在哪一年可以结束。§I得分§!最高者将会获得胜利。不过此后玩家仍可继续游戏。将滑条拉到最大数值将会关闭胜利计时。\n\n将此滑块设置到最大值将会禁止所有类型的定期胜利。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1739`

### English

§H$FE_VICTORY$§!\nThis controls at which year the game can end, if there is no active ['concept_endgame_crisis'] or ['concept_war_in_heaven']. The empire that has the highest §IScore§! will be declared the winner. It is still possible to keep playing past this year.\n\nSetting this slider to its maximum setting will disable timed victory altogether.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1798`

### 中文

The higher the multiplier, the more dangerous the end-game crises will be.\n\nIf the §ICrisis Type§! setting is set to §IAll§!, this value will be multiplied by 2 for each end-game crisis survived.\n\nOn §Y$DIFFICULTY_ENSIGN$ Difficulty§! and above, this will also affect the §YMid-Game Crises§!.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1822`

## FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFE_LOGISTIC_CEILING_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§!\n当星球的人口增长处于S型曲线的中段时，这一选项控制人口增长能够获得多大的加成。选项越高，人口增长越快。\n\n§R警告：§!调高选项可能导致后期游戏性能下降以及出现平衡相关的问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1771`

### English

§H$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§!\nThis controls how large the pop growth bonuses are when planets are in the middle of their logistic curve. The higher it is, the faster pops will grow.\n\n§RWarning:§! This setting may have late game performance and balance implications if increased.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1830`

## FE_GROWTH_SCALE_TOOLTIP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFE_GROWTH_SCALE_TOOLTIP&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$FE_GROWTH_SCALE$§!\n基于帝国人口的数量调节人口增长速率。越高，则人口增长越慢。\n\n§R警告：§!调低这一选项可能导致严重的性能下降以及产生平衡相关的问题，我们高度建议同时也降低§Y$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1773`

### English

§H$FE_GROWTH_SCALE$§!\nThis scales pop growth based on the number of pops in the empire. The higher it is, the slower pops will grow.\n\n§RWarning:§! Lowering this may have significant performance and balance implications, and decreasing §Y$FE_LOGISTIC_CEILING$§! alongside it is highly recommended.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:1832`

## stone_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Astone_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明目前处于石器时代。他们掌握了火，并发展出了基本的口头语言，但我们还没有发现他们有任何冶金或文字交流的证据。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1976`

### English

This civilization is currently in the equivalent of a Stone Age. They have mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2046`

## bronze_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abronze_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明目前处于青铜时代。早期金属冶炼技术和第一批书面语言开始出现，而城市和较大的聚落也初见雏形。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1978`

### English

This civilization is currently in the equivalent of a Bronze Age. Primitive metalworking and the first written languages have appeared, while cities and larger communities are taking shape.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2048`

## iron_age

## iron_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Airon_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明目前处于铁器时代。文明扩张的足迹遍布他们的星球，而钢铁的冶炼和锻造技术使他们有能力制造原始但却有效的工具和武器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1980`

### English

This civilization is currently in the equivalent of an Iron Age. They have spread across most of their homeworld, while iron smelting and forging techniques have enabled them to forge crude but effective tools and weaponry.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2050`

## late_medieval_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alate_medieval_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明目前处于中古时代后期。他们对金属冶炼技术的掌握愈发娴熟，而印刷机的发明也开始推动知识的传播。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1982`

### English

This civilization is currently experiencing the equivalent of a Late Medieval Age. They have a firm grasp of metallurgy, and the invention of the printing press has started to benefit the spread of knowledge.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2052`

## renaissance_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arenaissance_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明目前处于文艺复兴时代。各种科学知识正在以极快的速度被发现，火药的发明也彻底的改变了战争的格局。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1984`

### English

This civilization is currently experiencing the equivalent of a Renaissance Age. Scientific knowledge is increasing at a rapid rate, and the invention of gunpowder has revolutionized warfare.

## steam_age_desc

### 中文

这个文明目前处于蒸汽时代。蒸汽机的发明对他们的社会产生了深远的影响，他们正处于工业革命的风口浪尖上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1986`

### English

This civilization is currently in the equivalent of a Steam Age. The invention of the steam engine has had far-reaching effects on their society, and they stand on the cusp of an industrial revolution.

## industrial_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aindustrial_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明已经得以进入工业时代早期。电力和内燃机逐渐被广泛运用，城市化进程突飞猛进。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1988`

### English

This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of an early Industrial Age. Electricity and internal combustion engines are gradually coming into widespread use, while urbanization increases at a rapid pace.

## machine_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Amachine_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明已经进入了机械时代，相当于工业时代后期。他们的工厂实现了消费品和载具的大批量生产，而空中旅行也变得越来越普及。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1990`

### English

This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of a Machine Age, considered a later part of the Industrial Age. Their factories are mass-producing goods and vehicles, and air travel is becoming commonplace.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2060`

## atomic_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aatomic_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明已经进入了原子时代。他们已经可以使用原子能，但还没有将其运用在太空探索中。他们生产了大量的核武器，足以在一瞬间给整个物种以灭顶之灾。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1992`

### English

This civilization has advanced into the equivalent of an Atomic Age. They have harnessed the power of the atom, but have not yet made it into space. Nuclear weapons may be prolific, and could result in a sudden extinction event.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2062`

## early_space_age

## early_space_age_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aearly_space_age_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个文明已经进入太空时代早期。他们已经在自己母星的轨道上布置了早期卫星，也第一次实现了低轨道的载人航天。他们将很快准备好离开他们的星球进入太空。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:1994`

### English

This civilization has entered an Early Space Age. Primitive satellites are orbiting their homeworld, and the first manned space missions have been concluded in low orbit. They will soon be ready to leave their world.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2064`

## garrison_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agarrison_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

每个星球都有防御民兵，其规模取决于人口数量。民兵不能被运输。

## slave_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aslave_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

为了主人而战斗的奴隶士兵，绝大多数都是被迫参加战斗的，但是也有一些奴隶为了获得更多食物或逃离繁重的劳动从而自愿参加战斗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2457`

### English

Slave soldiers who serve their masters on the battlefield. Most are conscripted by force, but many slaves volunteer in a desperate attempt to increase their food rations or escape from grueling labor.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2565`

## clone_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aclone_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

专用克隆人可以在几个月内长成成人。尽管他们的自然寿命不足十年而且缺乏主观能动性，但可以用他们的对长官的绝对忠诚来弥补这些遗憾。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2461`

### English

Specialized clones that reach adulthood in a matter of months. With a natural lifespan of less than a decade, their lack of personal initiative is deemed an acceptable trade-off for their total obedience to officers.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2569`

## robotic_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arobotic_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

专为战斗而存在的冷血机器，它们为了完成任务可以不惜一切代价，不像有机体生物军团一样会受到士气低下的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2464`

### English

Cold and heartless killing-machines designed only for war. They pursue their objectives relentlessly, and are impervious to the shattering effects of poor morale that so often plague organic combat units.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2572`

## shroud_forged_defense_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ashroud_forged_defense_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

灵能调谐的合成人躯体守护着它们的世界，从虚境中汲取决心，这份信念是纯粹的机械单元所无法企及的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2470`

### English

Psionically-attuned synthetic frames standing watch over their worlds, drawing resolve from the Shroud with a conviction no purely mechanical unit can match.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2578`

## android_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aandroid_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

半自动的士兵组成这个加添满了油的战争机器。比起机器人，智能战斗员更灵活，更具侵略性，也能更好地处理各类战场情况。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2473`

### English

Semi-autonomous cogs in a well-oiled war machine, android combatants are more resilient, aggressive, and responsive to changing battlefield conditions than their robotic predecessors.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2581`

## psionic_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apsionic_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有着灵能能力的部队。他们破坏性的灵能让他们可以在战场使用不一样的战术——他们的首要目标往往是摧毁对方的战斗意志。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2479`

### English

Soldiers gifted with psionic abilities. Their focus on destructive psionic powers has led to drastically different tactics and strategies on the battlefield - their first objective is always to remove the enemy's willingness to fight.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2587`

## xenomorph_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Axenomorph_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

成千上万由生物工程设计的有着尖牙厉爪和对杀戮的渴望的饥饿怪兽。一群科学家在远离前线的坚固地堡里监督驱赶着这些暴怒的兽群。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2482`

### English

Ravenous hordes of bio-engineered horrors made up of little more than teeth, claws and an instinctive urge to kill. A cadre of scientists monitor and supervise the raging swarms as best they can from hardened bunkers behind the front.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2590`

## gene_warrior_army_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agene_warrior_army_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

基因改造的超级士兵。从传统的部队里招募精英作为新兵。然后进行基因改造使得他们比原来更大更强更快。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:2485`

### English

Genetically enhanced super soldiers. Recruits are typically chosen from the elite of the conventional military forces. These then undergo extensive gene therapy, and are made larger, stronger and faster than their former peers.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:2593`

## starting_weapons_lasers_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Astarting_weapons_lasers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这种直接利用能源的武器会向目标发射激光光束，对中近距离的敌人特别有效。可以无视敌人的装甲，但是会被护盾克制。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3343`

### English

These directed-energy weapons emit focused laser beams at their targets. They are effective at medium to close range, largely ignoring the bulk of enemy armor.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3471`

## starting_weapons_projectiles_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Astarting_weapons_projectiles_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

物质驱动器能够磁化投射物并朝目标加速射出，虽然说距离有限，但它们的强大动能和射速能够轻易击穿护盾。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3344`

### English

Mass Drivers that use electromagnetic catapults to accelerate projectiles towards targets at blinding speeds. While somewhat limited in range, their kinetic energy and high rate of fire chew through shields with ease.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3472`

## starting_weapons_missiles_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Astarting_weapons_missiles_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这种深空导弹搭载了核弹头。它们射程极远，但是它们也会被点防御系统轻易拦截。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3345`

### English

Space-to-space missiles armed with nuclear warheads. Missiles have excellent range, but they are vulnerable to interception by point-defense systems.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3473`

### English

### English

## starting_ftl_warp_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Astarting_ftl_warp_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

曲速引擎能够在舰船周围生成一层亚空间气泡，使舰船以超光速飞行。虽说这样可以自由选择飞行路线，但是考虑到恒星间的距离，这样移动还是比较慢的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3349`

### English

The warp drive generates a subspace bubble around a ship, making faster-than-light speeds attainable. This allows for free but relatively slow travel between stars, given the great distances involved.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3477`

## starting_ftl_hyperdrive_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Astarting_ftl_hyperdrive_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

超空间引擎将暂时突破维度限制，令舰船进入超空间。此引擎虽然可以在恒星间快速航行，但其航行自由性受限于现有的超空间航路网络。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3350`

### English

The hyper drive allows ships to temporarily breach the dimension of hyperspace. Interstellar travel is fast but limited to existing paths along the hyperlane network.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3478`

## starting_ftl_wormhole_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Astarting_ftl_wormhole_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

虫洞生成器将在亚空间建立一条空间隧道来连接空间上的两个坐标点，允许穿越非常远的距离。但是虫洞生成器由于体积过大无法装配在一般舰船上，所以需要一个特殊的虫洞生成空间站来实现旅行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3351`

### English

Wormhole generators tunnel through subspace and establish a conduit between two points, permitting travel across vast distances. The large generators are too big to be fitted on ships, requiring special Wormhole Stations to operate.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3479`

## TOOLTIP_SETUP_NAME_CLASS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATOOLTIP_SETUP_NAME_CLASS&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$GOVERNMENT_VIEW_CAPITAL_LABEL$§!\n请选择母星的类型并且为其命名。所选类型将意味着您的物种将最适应这种行星类型的自然环境。\n\n您的物种也可以在其他类型的星球殖民，殖民的难度取决于这些星球与您母星环境的差异。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3358`

### English

§H$GOVERNMENT_VIEW_CAPITAL_LABEL$§!\nSelect the planet class of your homeworld and customize its name. The planet class you select will also be the primary planet type for your species.\n\nOther planet classes can be inhabited by your species depending on how different they are from your planet class.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3487`

### 中文

§H$STARTING_WEAPONS$§!\n请为您的帝国选择一件起始武器科技。\n\n您可以在游戏中切换您想装配的武器类型。如果您想改变您的舰船装配武器种类，您可以查看您的舰船设计器：§Y舰船设计器§!。

### English

§H$STARTING_WEAPONS$§!\nSelect which starting weapon your empire's ships will be fitted with.\n\nYou will be able to change which weapon components your ships are fitted with during play. Check the §YShip Designer§! in game to change which components your ships will be fitted with.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3495`

## TOOLTIP_SETUP_FTL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATOOLTIP_SETUP_FTL&lang=en)

### 中文

§H$FTL_LABEL$§!\n选择您的旅行方式，在你解锁某些特别稀有的科技之前，您将无法修改您的移动方式。同时您的基础超光速移动方式是永远都不会更改的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3367`

### English

§H$FTL_LABEL$§!\nSelect which travel method your empire will use for interstellar travel. You will not be able to change your FTL-method unless you unlock some very rare technologies. You will never be able to change between the base types of FTL-travel during play.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3496`

## pc_molten_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_molten_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个被熔化了的星球。它的大气极其稀薄甚至没有大气，由于火山运动，内部的岩浆肆意在地表涌动。这种类型的星球无法维持有机生命的存活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3410`

### English

Rocky world that is scorching hot. The atmosphere is thin or non-existent, and lava from the interior flows freely due to constant volcanic eruptions. This type of planet cannot sustain organic life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3545`

## pc_frozen

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_frozen&lang=en)

### 中文

冰封星球

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3546`

## pc_frozen_plural

冰封星球

## pc_frozen_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_frozen_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一颗地表上覆盖着厚厚的永冻冰层的岩质星球。极低的温度和非常稀薄的大气令生命难以存活在它的地表上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3413`

### English

Rocky world covered in a thick layer of permanently frozen ice. Low temperatures and a very thin atmosphere preclude the existence of life on the surface.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3548`

## pc_broken

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_broken&lang=en)

### 中文

崩坏星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3414`

### English

Broken World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3549`

## pc_broken_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_broken_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

毁灭于一场大灾难的星球。不管该星球曾经拥有过怎样的财富，都早已灰飞烟灭踪迹难寻了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3415`

### English

World devastated by some catastrophic event. Whatever properties it may once have had are no longer discernible.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3550`

## pc_barren

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_barren&lang=en)

### 中文

荒芜星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3416`

### English

Barren World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3551`

## pc_barren_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_barren_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

荒芜的岩石星球，几乎不存在大气层。表面布满了陨石坑，完全没有生命存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3417`

### English

Barren and rocky world with a thin or non-existent atmosphere. The surface is covered in meteor impact craters and is completely devoid of life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3552`

## pc_barren_cold

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_barren_cold&lang=en)

### English

Barren World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3553`

## pc_barren_cold_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_barren_cold_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

荒芜的岩石星球，几乎不存在大气层。表面布满了陨石坑，完全没有生命存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3419`

### English

Barren and rocky world with a thin or non-existent atmosphere. The surface is covered in meteor impact craters and is completely devoid of life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3554`

## pc_desert

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_desert&lang=en)

### 中文

沙漠星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3420`

### English

Desert World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3555`

## pc_desert_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_desert_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

干燥的岩石世界，有氮氧大气层，几乎没有大片水体或者降水存在。昼夜温差巨大。很少有植物，但只要有适量降雨就能使沙漠变得生机勃勃。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3421`

### English

Dry, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Precipitation and major bodies of surface water are relatively rare. Significant temperature variations between day and night cycles. Vegetation is scarce, but even moderate precipitation can make the desert bloom.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3556`

## pc_arid

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_arid&lang=en)

### 中文

干旱星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3422`

### English

Arid World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3557`

## pc_arid_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_arid_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

干旱的岩石世界，有氮氧大气层，表面多是峭壁和峡谷，可以在气候更加温和的极地地区发现树林，但其它植物比较稀缺。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3423`

### English

Dry, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The dust-covered terrain consists largely of mesas and canyons. Forests can be found in the more temperate polar regions, but vegetation is otherwise scarce.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3558`

## pc_tundra

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_tundra&lang=en)

### 中文

苔原星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3424`

### English

Tundra World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3559`

## pc_tundra_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_tundra_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一颗寒冷的岩态星球，大气充斥着氮氧元素。除了更温和的赤道地区以外，大部分地表都被永久冻土层覆盖。这里存在一个稳定的生物圈，但植被大多仅限于苔藓和地衣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3425`

### English

Cold and rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Permafrost covers most of the surface except for the more temperate equatorial regions. A stable biosphere exists but vegetation is mostly limited to mosses and lichens.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3560`

## pc_continental

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_continental&lang=en)

### 中文

陆地星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3426`

### English

Continental World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3561`

## pc_continental_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_continental_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有氮氧大气层的岩石世界，存在稳定的水源，有被海洋分割开的大陆，随经纬度不同有不同的季节温度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3427`

### English

Rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Active and stable hydrosphere. Great landmasses are separated by oceans, with large climate variations depending on latitude and precipitation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3562`

## pc_tropical

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_tropical&lang=en)

### 中文

热带星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3428`

### English

Tropical World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3563`

## pc_tropical_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_tropical_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有厚重氮氧大气层的潮湿岩石世界，气候变化巨大，旱季和雨季交替明显。绝大部分的大陆上都覆盖着茂盛的植被。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3429`

### English

Humid, rocky world with a thick nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Seasons with significant precipitation are interchanged with drier periods. Most landmasses are covered in dense vegetation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3564`

## pc_ocean

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_ocean&lang=en)

海洋星球

### English

### 中文

海洋星球

### English

Ocean Worlds

## pc_ocean_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_ocean_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有大量水源和氮氧大气层的岩石世界，海洋覆盖了§Y90%§!以上的表面，剩下的陆地均为岛屿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3432`

### English

Rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and a significant hydrosphere. Oceans cover more than §Y90%§! of the surface, with scattered islands making up the remaining percentage.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3567`

## pc_arctic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_arctic&lang=en)

### 中文

极地星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3433`

### English

Arctic World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3568`

## pc_arctic_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_arctic_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

主要由极地组成的岩石世界，有氮氧大气层，极地范围很大，冰雪覆盖了大部分的表面，但仍然有四季变化，同时赤道地区也有植被。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3434`

### English

Frigid, rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The poles are big, and significant water deposits can be found permanently frozen as glacial ice. However, the planet experiences seasonal variations and the equatorial band is covered by vegetation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3569`

## pc_alpine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_alpine&lang=en)

### 中文

高山星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3435`

### English

Alpine World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3570`

## pc_alpine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_alpine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个拥有氮氧大气层的山地星球。积雪终年覆盖山顶，山谷点缀着冻结的湖泊。虽然这个行星只有微小的季节变化，但在冻结的湖面底下仍然流动着液态水，并且足以维持一些耐寒植物的日常所需。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3436`

### English

Mountainous world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. Snow covers the mountaintops, and frozen-over lakes dot the valleys. While the planet experiences minimal seasonal variations, the still-liquid water beneath the frozen surface of the lakes is enough to sustain some hardy vegetation.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3571`

## pc_savannah

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_savannah&lang=en)

### 中文

草原星球

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3437`

### English

Savanna World

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3572`

## pc_savannah_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_savannah_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

有着氮氧大气层的岩石星球，有大片平原存在。较小的水圈只能支持短暂的雨季。除了几种比较普遍的杂草，其它的植被主要存在于绿洲附近。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3438`

### English

Rocky world dominated by dry, arid plains covered by a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere. The small hydrosphere allows for brief wet seasons, but aside from a few ubiquitous grasses, vegetation is largely concentrated around shallow oases.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3573`

## pc_habitat

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_habitat&lang=en)

### English

Orbital Habitat

## pc_habitat_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_habitat_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一座人造的深空居所，能提供仿佛行星一般的居住体验，具体而言是指行星上的城市区域。水培农场和先进的过滤科技使其可以几乎长期自持，在居住站上建造的设施则可以开采其环绕的行星上的资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3441`

### English

An artificial deep-space arcology offering planet-like - if decidedly urban - living conditions. Hydroponics and advanced filtering technologies make it near-self-sustaining, and station-borne facilities can mine the station's host planet for raw materials.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3576`

### 中文

有剧毒大气层的岩石世界，任何高级生命体都无法生存。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3444`

### English

A rocky planet with a thick atmosphere that is lethal to all known higher forms of life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3579`

### 中文

我们的探测器不能穿透围绕在这个行星周围的迷雾。进入迷雾的舰船有去无回。

Our sensors are unable to penetrate the thick fog surrounding the planet. Ships that enter it do not return.

### English

## pc_b_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_b_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

体积庞大的B型主序星大多星等极低而且泛蓝。虽然这种恒星比较罕见，但B型恒星的亮度使他们在夜空中脱颖而出。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3450`

### English

The large class B main-sequence stars are very bright and blue. Although somewhat rare, the luminosity of these stars make them among the most visible to the naked eye.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3585`

## pc_a_star

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_a_star&lang=en)

### 中文

A型恒星

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3451`

### English

Class A Star

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3586`

## pc_a_star_short

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_a_star_short&lang=en)

A型

### English

Class A

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3587`

## pc_a_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_a_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些相对年轻的白色或青白色的主序星通常是肉眼观测中最引人注目的。它们体积巨大并且自转飞速，但最终会演变成慢速的低温的红巨星。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3453`

### English

These relatively young white or bluish-white main-sequence stars are typically among the most visible to the naked eye. They are large and rotate very quickly, but will eventually evolve into slower and cooler red giants.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3588`

## pc_f_star

F型恒星

### English

Class F Star

## pc_f_star_short

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_f_star_short&lang=en)

F型

### English

Class F

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3590`

## pc_f_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_f_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

F型恒星的体积是相当大的，通常被称为黄白矮星。虽然他们经常发射出大量的紫外线辐射，但它们的广泛的宜居带为生命的存在提供了一个很好的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3456`

### English

F-type stars are fairly large and often referred to as yellow-white dwarfs. Although they often emit significant amounts of UV radiation, their wide habitable zones have a good chance of supporting life-bearing worlds.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3591`

## pc_g_star

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_g_star&lang=en)

### 中文

G型恒星

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3457`

### English

Class G Star

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3592`

## pc_g_star_short

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_g_star_short&lang=en)

### 中文

G型

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3458`

### English

Class G

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3593`

## pc_g_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_g_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

G型恒星通常被称为黄矮星，实际上G型恒星的颜色范围是从白色到微黄色。主序星在演变成红巨星前，往往先需要聚变约100亿年。虽然它们的寿命短于K型恒星，但G型恒星往往被认为更加适合生命的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3459`

### English

Often referred to as yellow dwarfs, G-type stars actually range in color from white to slightly yellow. Main-sequence stars fuse hydrogen for roughly 10 billion years before they expand and become red giants. Although their lifespans are shorter than K-type stars, worlds inside the habitable zone of a G star often enjoy optimal conditions for the development of life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3594`

## pc_k_star

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_k_star&lang=en)

### 中文

K型恒星

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3460`

### English

Class K Star

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3595`

## pc_k_star_short

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_k_star_short&lang=en)

### 中文

K型

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3461`

### English

Class K

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3596`

## pc_k_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_k_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这些主序星通常被称作橙矮星，它们在宇宙中非常普遍。它们可以在主序星列中至少存在三百亿年，这意味着K型恒星的行星上的生命可以拥有一个非常漫长又安稳的进化过程。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3462`

### English

These main-sequence stars, sometimes referred to as orange dwarfs, are a fairly common sight. They are stable on the main-sequence for up to 30 billion years, meaning that worlds orbiting a K-type star have a longer than average window to evolve life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3597`

## pc_m_star

M型恒星

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3463`

## pc_m_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_m_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

宇宙中最为普遍存在的恒星类型，往往被称为红矮星。它们的亮度很低，这意味着它们很难被肉眼观察到。尽管他们拥有非常长的寿命，很少发射出紫外线的红矮星对大多数生命的维持和居住是不利的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3466`

### English

The most common stars in the universe, often referred to as red dwarfs. Their low luminosity means they are difficult to observe with the naked eye from afar. Although they typically have an extremely long lifespan, red dwarfs emit almost no UV light resulting in unfavorable conditions for most forms of life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3601`

### 中文

褐矮星

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3469`

### English

Brown Dwarfs

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3604`

## pc_t_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_t_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

褐矮星是缺乏足够大质量来维持氢融合反应的次恒星。尽管尺寸上和气态巨行星相差无几，但其密度要远大于后者。由于光强较弱且产生热量很少，褐矮星几乎无法给环绕它的行星提供维持生命必须的环境。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3470`

### English

Brown dwarfs are substellar objects that lack the mass to sustain hydrogen fusion. Roughly the size of large gas giants, they have a much greater density. Their low luminosity and comparatively small heat generation means that planets orbiting them are unlikely to support life.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3605`

## pc_m_giant_star

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_m_giant_star&lang=en)

### 中文

M型红巨星

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3471`

### English

Class M Red Giant

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3606`

## pc_m_giant_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_m_giant_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

红巨星拥有极大的半径和相对较低的表面温度，是拥有适中质量的恒星演化到衰变期时的形态。红巨星膨胀的大气层和强烈的光强可能会形成距离红巨星十分遥远的宜居带。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3472`

### English

With a large radius and comparatively low surface temperature, red giants are stars of moderate mass in a late stage of stellar evolution. Their expanded stellar atmospheres and high luminosity make for distant habitable zone orbits.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3607`

## pc_black_hole_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_black_hole_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

黑洞通常是由非常大质量的恒星在其寿命周期结束时坍塌而形成的，黑洞具有极强的重力场，能够阻止一切事物——包括光——逃逸出其视界边界。黑洞发出的引力波会干扰超光速引擎的工作，使战舰难以紧急脱离战斗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3475`

### English

Typically formed as a result of the collapse of a very massive star at the end of its life cycle, black holes have extremely strong gravity fields that prevent anything - including light - from escaping once the event horizon has been crossed. The gravitational waves emitted by black holes interfere with FTL drives, making it harder for ships to escape from combat.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3610`

### English

### English

## pc_neutron_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_neutron_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一些大质量恒星在迅速坍缩并爆炸成为超新星时，会产生这些令人难以置信的恒星残骸，虽然它们的直径通常只有十公里，但它们的质量比一般的G型恒星大了很多倍。中子星所发出的引力波和辐射使得船员们在经过时必须谨慎导航，从而导致了船只在经过该区域时的亚光速航行速度显著降低。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3478`

### English

These incredibly dense stellar remnants are sometimes created when a massive star suffers a rapid collapse and explodes in a supernova. Although their diameter is typically as little as ten kilometers, their mass is many times greater than an average G-type star. The gravitational waves and radiation emitted by neutron stars must be carefully navigated around, slowing the sublight speed of ships.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3613`

### English

## pc_pulsar_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_pulsar_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

脉冲星是能够发射电磁辐射的高度磁化的中子星。当恒星高速旋转时，辐射束仅在其轴线直接指向观察者时才可见。该现象产生了一个非常精确的脉冲间隔，这种脉冲有时非常精确，可以用来精确测量时间的流逝。脉冲星发射的辐射会干扰护盾偏转器技术，导致船舶和地面护盾无法使用。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3481`

### English

Pulsars are highly magnetized neutron stars that emit beams of electromagnetic radiation. As the star rotates, the radiation beam is only visible when it is pointing directly at the observer. This results in a very precise interval of pulses, which sometimes is so exact that it can be used to measure the passage of time with extreme accuracy. The radiation emitted by pulsars interferes with deflector technology, rendering ship and station shields inoperable.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3616`

## pc_toxoid_star_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_toxoid_star_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

数千年与毒性神衹的接触导致这颗恒星的构成发生了变化。它曾是一颗相当标准的G型恒星，但现在它散发出一种与星系系其他地方不同的怪异绿色薄雾。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3483`

### English

Millennia of exposure to the Toxic Entity have caused alterations in the makeup of this star. Though once it was a fairly standard G-type star, now it emits an eerie green haze unlike any seen elsewhere in the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3618`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_nuked_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一颗大气中充斥着氮氧元素的岩态行星。目前它正处于核冬天，大气中含有乌黑浓厚的悬浮颗粒。表面辐射水平高。鲜有生命迹象。

## pc_ringworld_habitable_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_ringworld_habitable_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该巨型环带是环形世界的一部分，它环绕着恒星系中的恒星。\n不像球形行星那样拥有诸多限制，内圈有大量人造宜居空间。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3494`

### English

Part of a Ring World, an immense band encircling the system's sun.\nBuilt to allow for numerous artificial habitation zones along its inner span, freed from the restrictions and mundanity of planet-bound, spherical existence.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3629`

## pc_ai_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_ai_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一颗地表覆盖着人造建筑的岩态星球。稀薄的大气主要由工业污染物组成。巨量的能源从整个星球的地表排放出来，但是没有任何有机生命体的反应。

## pc_hive_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apc_hive_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这整个世界其实就是一个巨大的生物体，由蜂巢思维通过灵能所操纵。任何不属于蜂巢意识体的生物一旦进入该世界将会受到整个行星的攻击。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3515`

### English

This entire world is a giant living organism, psionically connected with the Hive Mind that shaped it. Any beings not part of the Hive that set foot here will be attacked by the very terrain itself.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3650`

### 中文

曾经是一颗星球的焦黑残骸。一股巨大的能源波动引爆了这颗星球的核心，只剩下了漂浮的石块。

这片区域曾遭到大量核弹头袭击。尽管其辐射量与爆炸时相比已经减少了许多，但仍需要展开大规模清理才可居住。

这片焦黑并充满辐射的废墟曾经是一座有机生物的大都市。仍未倒下的那些建筑里现在也只剩下灰烬了。

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_former_battlefield_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

无数烧焦的战争机器，以及有机生物战士们的骸骨遍布于这片曾经的战场上。残余的辐射会对大部分电子设备造成干扰。

## d_strip_mine_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_strip_mine_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这一区域在过去经历了高强度的露天开采，当时负责开采的原始陈旧机器未将该地区未来的发展纳入考虑范畴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:3657`

### 中文

在这颗星球上，一小群有机生物社会仍存在于机械管理之外。暴力、疾病和饥荒在居住地的高墙内肆虐，其居民的科技水平已经倒退了数个世纪。

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:3799`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFLEETORDER_JUMP_DRIVE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

命令选中的装有跃迁引擎的舰队跳跃到指定星系，绕开超空间通道。跃迁后，在跃迁引擎可以被再次使用前，它需要$DAYS|Y$天时间充能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4322`

### English

Order selected Jump Drive-equipped fleets to make a jump to selected system, bypassing hyperlanes completely. After jumping, the Jump Drive needs $DAYS|Y$ days to recharge before it can be used again.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4479`

## FLEETORDER_ESN_DESC

### 中文

命令科研船暂时无视稳定的超空间航道，通过起伏动荡的亚空间洼地前往指定目的地。在前往目的地的这段时间，科研船会被视为§Y失踪§!。

### English

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_uplifted_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这个物种是从仅有直觉和基础情绪的状态中提升而来。他们现在身负智慧，就必须去学会驾驭自由意志。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4423`

### English

§LThis species was uplifted from an existence of instinct and base emotion. Now burdened with sapience, they must learn to navigate free will.§!\n

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_resilient_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这个物种在受伤之后能够快速复原，并会像狂怒的育母蜘蛛一样通过战斗来保护他们的星球。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4461`

### English

机械体

Mechanical

## trait_mechanical_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_mechanical_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L机械体比传统的专用机器人复杂好几个数量级，但是大多数也只掌握着有限的处理能力。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4463`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4623`

## trait_robotic_1

机器人

### English

Robot

## trait_robotic_1_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_robotic_1_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L机器人是相对简单的机械体，他们能够处理口头命令，但自己没有拥有真正的智慧。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4465`

### English

§LRobots are relatively simple machines, capable of accepting verbal commands but possessing no true intelligence of their own.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4625`

## trait_robot_awoken_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_robot_awoken_01&lang=en)

### 中文

永锢灵薄

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4466`

### English

Forever in Limbo

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4626`

## trait_robot_awoken_01_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_robot_awoken_01_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由于无法解释的系统错误和连绵不休的机械故障，这些古老的外星人并没有很好地适应他们新的机械躯体。然而，他们在这过程表现出了一种非同寻常的科学才能，这在之前的低级机器人中是闻所未闻的，这也许是一种处于困境之中的智慧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4467`

### English

Riddled with inexplicable errors and constant breakdowns, the ancient aliens have not acclimatized well to their new mechanical bodies. Yet they display an unusual aptitude for science, previously unheard of in low-level robots - an indicator, perhaps, of the intellect trapped within.

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4627`

## trait_robot_awoken

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_robot_awoken&lang=en)

### 中文

觉醒者

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4468`

### English

Awoken

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4628`

## trait_robot_awoken_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_robot_awoken_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

觉醒者，即使在机械躯体内，依然保持了之前的特质。浪费成性的习惯和停滞不前的生活方式是该科技高度发达的古老真菌物种衰落的原因吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4469`

### English

Even in mechanical form the Awoken have kept some of their original traits. Could wasteful habits and a sedentary lifestyle have been the downfall of this ancient race of scientifically advanced fungi?

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4629`

## trait_robotic_2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_robotic_2&lang=en)

### 中文

§L智能人是一种更加复杂的机器人，他们往往有预先设定好的人格来更好地取悦自己的主人，他们的智能非常有限。§!\n

### 中文

§L这种合成人是一种比常规有机生命更具优势的精密机械。他们的中央处理器能够承载七级人工智能，以实现完全自我意识。§!\n

## trait_lithoid_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_lithoid_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L这一物种属于硅基生命体，靠矿物而非食物维生。它们比传统的有机生命更为坚韧，代谢缓慢，因而寿命更长却也繁殖缓慢。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:4486`

### English

§LThis species has a silicon based biology, and consumes minerals rather than food. They are tougher than traditional organics and have slower metabolisms, making them long lived but slow to reproduce.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:4646`

§L这些可折叠的劳工单位有着灵活的关节，这使他们能在运输过程中整齐地折叠成一堆，然后在现场自行组装。§!\n

§L拥有镀铬钛合金制成的防护外骨骼，这些重型机器专为严酷环境而设计，只需要极少的维护。§!\n

## trait_robot_high_bandwidth_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrait_robot_high_bandwidth_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L每个个体单位均会发送和接收大量的重复数据，使得各中央处理单元附属的单位数量增加时带来的延迟指数增长。§!

§L预测算法可以实现最大的优化。市场上无穷小的波动，无论是流通率、库存情况、有机客户的情绪反应都会被纳入考量。§!

## ethic_authoritarian

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_authoritarian&lang=en)

### 中文

威权主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5112`

### English

Authoritarian

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5291`

## ethic_authoritarian_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_authoritarian_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L一个强大的能起引导作用的力量，对于任何文明的成功都是至关重要的——否则国家将陷入无政府与混乱。领导民众走向生产力最高的道路是国家的职责。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5113`

### English

§LA strong, guiding hand is essential to the success of any civilization - the alternative would be anarchy and chaos. It is the duty of the state to steer its citizens towards the paths that are the most productive.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5292`

## ethic_fanatic_authoritarian

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_authoritarian&lang=en)

### 中文

极端威权主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5114`

### English

Fanatic Authoritarian

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5293`

## ethic_fanatic_authoritarian_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_authoritarian_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L同一个声音，同一个权力，同一个国家。所有的民众，都有着庄严的义务去服从明智的少数人。而这些少数人承担了领导民众的巨大责任。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5115`

### English

§LA single voice, a single throne, a single state. It is the solemn duty of the masses to obey those enlightened few who have been charged with the great responsibility of leadership.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5294`

## ethic_egalitarian

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_egalitarian&lang=en)

### 中文

平等主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5116`

### English

Egalitarian

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5295`

## ethic_egalitarian_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_egalitarian_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L平等的社会中所有个体都应当能通过足够努力的工作获得更高的地位。任何拒绝信奉其成员应当平等的社会，不仅严重缺乏公正，更是彻底误入歧途。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5117`

### English

§LAny society that does not embrace equality between its members - where an individual can rise to any position with enough hard work - is not only deeply unfair, but ultimately counterproductive.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5296`

## ethic_fanatic_egalitarian

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_egalitarian&lang=en)

### 中文

极端平等主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5118`

### English

Fanatic Egalitarian

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5297`

## ethic_fanatic_egalitarian_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_egalitarian_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L时刻警惕那些会成为独裁者的人，在他们错误的假定中，个人的欲望与事项凌驾于他们的追随者之上。一个不重视其所有成员需求和利益的社会不是社会——而是一个犯罪组织。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5119`

### English

§LBeware always those who would be despots, under the false presumption that their desires and agendas are somehow more imperative than those of their fellows. A society that does not see to the needs and rights of all of its members is not a society - it is a crime.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5298`

## ethic_xenophobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_xenophobe&lang=en)

### 中文

排外主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5120`

### English

Xenophobe

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5299`

## ethic_xenophobe_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_xenophobe_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L我们已经在冒着巨大的风险探索星海，任何不解与未知都被猜忌所巨大化。对于异族生物的信任是毫无意义的，跨物种与意识形态的差异将导致宇宙社会不再是个童话里的森林。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5121`

### English

§LThe stakes could not be higher as we reach into the vast uncharted expanses of the galaxy, for we are gambling with the very survival of our species! Never trust the alien; its false smile hides an unknowable mind...§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5300`

## ethic_fanatic_xenophobe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_xenophobe&lang=en)

### 中文

极端排外主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5122`

### English

Fanatic Xenophobe

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5301`

## ethic_fanatic_xenophobe_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_xenophobe_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L一切来自异星人的影响都必须毫不留情地抹除干净。唯有保持纯净，坚守真我，对哺育了我们文明的世界保持忠诚，才能确保我们免受异种邪恶阴谋的腐蚀。纵然实力与地位凌驾于异星人之上，亦不足以让我们高枕无忧……§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5123`

### English

§LAny alien influence must be ruthlessly quashed. Only by staying pure, and true to ourselves and the planet that gave us life can we guard against insidious Xeno plots. Even mastery over the Alien might not be enough to guarantee our own safety...§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5302`

## ethic_xenophile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_xenophile&lang=en)

### 中文

亲外主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5124`

### English

Xenophile

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5303`

## ethic_xenophile_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_xenophile_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L我们的内心中都存在着一份对于未知的好奇心，我们愿意与任何物种建立交流，来让自己知道得更多，了解得更多。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5125`

### English

§LThere exists, in all of us, a deep-seated fascination for the unknown. An adventurous spirit that rejects the familiar and glories in the unfamiliar, whatever - or whomever - it may be.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5304`

## ethic_fanatic_xenophile

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_xenophile&lang=en)

### 中文

极端亲外主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5126`

### English

Fanatic Xenophile

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5305`

## ethic_fanatic_xenophile_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_xenophile_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L如果在我们的社会中存在一个绝对的道德法则，那就是探索深空与外星人，并与他们融为一体。星海漫漫，但我们从不孤独。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5127`

### English

§LIf there ever was such a thing as an absolute moral imperative, it would be to explore the cosmos and embrace all within it. We were never meant to journey alone.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5306`

## ethic_militarist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_militarist&lang=en)

### 中文

军国主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5128`

### English

Militarist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5307`

## ethic_militarist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_militarist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L我们相信唯一的真正的美德是勇气和纪律，武装力量能够更好地保护自己，胜过任何脆弱的约定与诺言。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5129`

### English

§LThe only true virtues are courage and discipline, and channeled properly they can overcome any obstacle. Therein lies true strength; force withheld, a promise made.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5308`

## ethic_fanatic_militarist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_militarist&lang=en)

### 中文

极端军国主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5130`

### English

Fanatic Militarist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5309`

## ethic_fanatic_militarist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_militarist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L在这个无助的深空中，没有什么比武力更具备话语权。这个宇宙不是一个摇篮，也没有任何的道德约束。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5131`

### English

§LThe ability to project force is of paramount importance. The only way to preserve our way of life is to make sure everyone shares it; willingly or not...§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5310`

## ethic_pacifist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_pacifist&lang=en)

### 中文

和平主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5132`

### English

Pacifist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5311`

## ethic_pacifist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_pacifist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L我们认为任何事情都可以被和平地解决，冲突带来的结果是破坏性的，甚至会破坏我们互相争夺的东西。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5133`

### English

§LConflict as a means to an end is a ridiculous concept. It is by nature destructive, destroying what was to be obtained or giving room to grow that which was to be destroyed.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5312`

## ethic_fanatic_pacifist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_pacifist&lang=en)

### 中文

极端和平主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5134`

### English

Fanatic Pacifist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5313`

## ethic_fanatic_pacifist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_pacifist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L作为文明的化身，我们认为武力无法解决任何问题，战争只能带来痛苦与死亡，所有人都会因此付出巨大而无谓的代价。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5135`

### English

§LAs civilized beings, the end of all armed conflict should be our primary concern. War is an evolutionary dead end, as futile as it is wasteful.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5314`

## ethic_spiritualist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_spiritualist&lang=en)

### 中文

唯心主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5136`

### English

Spiritualist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5315`

## ethic_spiritualist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_spiritualist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L有人认为我们应当记住我们是如何的藐小，我们的生命在巨大而冷漠的宇宙中是如何的没有意义……这是多么的不可理喻！我们能够所知的唯一真相就是我们的存在。宇宙——无论它拥有多少浮于表面的称颂——也不过是我们偶然分享的梦境而已。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5137`

### English

§LThere are those who think it behooves us to remember how tiny we are, how pointless our lives are in this vast uncaring universe... What nonsense! The only truth we can ever know is that of our own existence. The universe - in all its apparent glory - is but a dream we all happen to share.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5316`

## ethic_fanatic_spiritualist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_spiritualist&lang=en)

### 中文

极端唯心主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5138`

### English

Fanatic Spiritualist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5317`

## ethic_fanatic_spiritualist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_spiritualist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L我们的科学已经证明了意识乃现实之父。我们耐心的审视那些用其他的世界观欺骗自己的人，他们做着孩童般幼稚的努力，翻弄着他们的一块块“实在的物质”。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5139`

### English

§LOur science has proved that Consciousness begets reality. We regard with patience the childlike efforts of those who delude themselves it is the other way around, as they play with their blocks of "hard matter."§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5318`

## ethic_materialist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_materialist&lang=en)

### 中文

唯物主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5140`

### English

Materialist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5319`

## ethic_materialist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_materialist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L我们认为在一个物种接触太空时就必须抛开所有幼稚的事物，比如宗教与神明这种虚幻的东西。现实是残酷而无情的，我们坚定信心，通过对科学的坚定不移的追求来切实维护族群的生存空间。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5141`

### English

§LAs we reach for the stars, we must put away childish things; gods, spirits and other phantasms of the brain. Reality is cruel and unforgiving, yet we must steel ourselves and secure the survival of our race through the unflinching pursuit of science and technology.§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5320`

## ethic_fanatic_materialist

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_materialist&lang=en)

### 中文

极端唯物主义

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5142`

### English

Fanatic Materialist

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5321`

## ethic_fanatic_materialist_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aethic_fanatic_materialist_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§L尽管这很残酷，但是我们必须成长起来，抛弃我们过时的道德观念。没有所谓的“神圣的思维火花”赋予生命体某种特殊的价值。除了我们选择授予的，没有任何东西拥有内在的独一无二的价值。让我们拥抱确信的自由，然后在所有的方面都达到最高的效率！§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/main_1_l_simp_chinese.yml:5143`

### English

§LAlthough it hurts, we must grow up and put aside our outdated notions of morality. There is no "divine spark" granting special value to a living mind. No object has any intrinsic value apart from what we choose to grant it. Let us embrace the freedom of certitude, and achieve maximum efficiency in all things!§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/main_1_l_english.yml:5322`
